name: team series conversion rate from plays range year_offset pools numerator/denominator (wrap)
description: is_rate column whose numerator/denominator are COUNT(DISTINCT ...) series expressions: the range path pools the distinct-counted num/den over the offset window under wrap mode rather than summing per-season conversion rates.
expected_query: with "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225" as materialized (select "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team" as "nfl_team", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN series_result IN ('FIRST_DOWN', 'TOUCHDOWN') THEN CONCAT(nfl_plays.esbid, '_', series_sequence) END) as team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_numerator, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN series_result NOT IN ('QB_KNEEL', 'END_OF_HALF') THEN CONCAT(nfl_plays.esbid, '_', series_sequence) END) as team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_denominator, "nfl_plays"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_plays"."week" from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in "nfl_plays"."season_year", "nfl_plays"."week"), "player_week_appearances" as (select "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week", "nfl_games"."esbid" as "esbid", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team" as "nfl_team" from "player_gamelogs" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "player_gamelogs"."esbid" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2024, 2025) and "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2024, 2025)), "player_week_teams" as (select "pid", "year", "week", "esbid", "nfl_team", max(nfl_team) over (partition count(week_appearance.nfl_team) over (partition by spine_players.pid, spine.year order by spine.week rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as appearance_group from (select distinct "player_gamelogs"."pid", "player_gamelogs"."season_year" as "year" from "player_gamelogs" where "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2024, 2025)) as "spine_players" inner join (select distinct "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2024, 2025)) as "spine" on sum(t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225.team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_denominator) as team_series_conversion_rate_from_plays_denominator from "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225" inner join "player_week_teams" on "player_week_teams"."nfl_team_most_recent" = "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225"."nfl_team" and "player_week_teams"."year" = "t041090d274b6c97f8cae71efc6966225"."year" and
